title: Plugin architecture
goal: Represent an extensible host with abstract plugin specializations.

rubric.must: ExportPlugin and ValidationPlugin have hollow-triangle generalization arrows pointing to abstract Plugin.
Both concrete plugins have dashed realization arrows to Configurable.
Plugin is visibly abstract and shows a protected # name member.
PluginRegistry aggregates Plugin with a hollow diamond and 0..* multiplicity.
AnalyticsHost has a directed association to PluginRegistry.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the umlclass exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly represents the requested abstract plugin hierarchy, interface realizations, registry aggregation, and host dependency. Connections are traceable and labels are readable; no material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: ExportPlugin and ValidationPlugin connect to Plugin through solid generalization lines with hollow triangles pointing to Plugin.
Both concrete plugins connect to Configurable with dashed lines ending in hollow triangles at the interface.
Plugin is labeled {abstract}, and its name member is shown with protected visibility (# name: String).
PluginRegistry connects to Plugin with a hollow diamond at the registry end and 0..* at the Plugin end; the relationship is labeled “registered plugins.”
AnalyticsHost has a directed association to PluginRegistry labeled “resolves.”
